pages.title: Photonic Die
pages.text: A single photonic logic die cut from its wafer. It is a tiny square of crystal whose engraved waveguides carry light through logic gates, and it glows faintly when powered. It is small enough to lose in a pocket, and I have.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Planck-Scale Cutter diced a Photonic Logic Wafer in superfluid helium, separating each logic unit cleanly. The first die worked on the first try, which I recorded with some suspicion.
